mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 41 degrees with clear skies by the Military Ridge State Trail and a New Moon overhead, with an overnight low of 36 degrees and no rain in the forecast.

The city has announced pavement repair work for November 10 and 11. Crews will be milling and patching areas on North Nine Mound Road, Morningside Boulevard, Mozart Street, Todd Street, Edward Street, and near Hemlock Drive, so please watch for no parking signs between 7 AM and 7 PM.

We have a busy week ahead starting with Yoga at Insight Wellness tomorrow. Tuesday features a packed schedule of trivia at Hop Haus, Wisconsin Brewing Company, and Paddy Mac's, plus live music at Paddy Mac's and pizza and a pitcher specials at Lake Lou-ee.

Regarding the weekly report, on October 25, officers located a 40-year-old Verona man passed out behind the wheel at Plympton Street and Rita Avenue, resulting in an arrest for an O W I, first offence.
Culver's of Verona has finished their day with today's flavor, Snickers Swirl. We look forward to seeing everyone tomorrow for the Georgia Peach flavor of the day when the store opens at 10:00 AM.
